Nosotros

Speedy Insurance Agency

Speedy Insurance Agency has delivered insurance coverage to satisfied clients for over 20 years. We research and review rates from hundreds of companies to find our customers the best rates available — we want each client to have the cheapest rates with quality coverage.

Our services include auto, motorcycle, home, recreational vehicles, general liability, DMV services, SR-22 filings, bonds, and commercial insurance. Our team of licensed and dedicated professional agents are committed above all to customer trust.

We love helping new clients explore their options and match policies to their personal needs. Our top priority is confident, satisfied customers. Speedy Insurance Agency was founded — and is still fueled by — a vision to educate and assist clients navigating the complex world of insurance. Insurance shopping doesn't have to be difficult.

Our bilingual team speaks English and Spanish. We are open Lun–Vie 9am–7pm, Sáb 9am–5pm, across 4 locations in Moreno Valley, Riverside, and Lake Elsinore.

Legal

Política de Privacidad

We value your privacy. We may collect personal information from you such as identifying information (name, address, driver's license number), transactional information (products or services purchased and payment history), digital network activity (interactions with our website, IP address), geo-location data, audio recordings and other forms of personal information. We use this information for business, marketing and commercial purposes. Personal information, such as phone numbers and SMS consent, will not be shared, sold, rented, or disclosed to any third parties for marketing purposes.

About This Policy

Speedy Insurance Agency ("Speedy Insurance", "we", "our", or "us") has adopted this Política de Privacidad to establish and maintain an adequate level of personal information privacy protection. This Policy explains the information we collect through our website, mobile applications, email, phone, and other sources, why we collect it, how we use and share it, and the choices you can make regarding your information.

Information We Collect From You

During the quoting, application, or claims handling process you may provide us with:

  • Name, address, phone number, email address
  • Driver's license number
  • VIN and/or vehicle information
  • Date of birth
  • Payment and billing information

Sharing excludes text messaging originator opt-in data and consent; this information will not be shared with any third parties.

How We Use Your Information

We use your information to process and service your policy, settle claims, confirm your identity, protect against fraud, and offer you other insurance and financial products. We may also use it to send you marketing communications via email, postal mail, social media, or text message about Speedy Insurance services and events.

Information From Third Parties

We may receive information about you from consumer reporting agencies, which provide us with motor vehicle reports and/or claim reports where permitted by law. If you commit to purchasing a policy, we will confirm your motor vehicle record and claims history.

SMS Communications

By providing your phone number, you agree that Speedy Insurance Agency may send text messages related to insurance products, services, policy updates, billing, and account notifications. Mobile opt-in, SMS consent, and phone numbers are not shared with any third parties for marketing purposes.

  • Message and data rates may apply.
  • Reply STOP to opt out at any time. Reply START to opt back in.
  • Reply HELP for assistance or visit our Política de Privacidad.
  • SMS frequency: between 5–1,000 messages daily company-wide.

Confidentiality & Security

We restrict access to your information to employees who need it to provide products or services to you. We maintain strict physical, electronic, and procedural safeguards to protect your information from unauthorized access by third parties. We use cookies on our website to improve your experience; most browsers allow you to control cookie settings.

California Residents (CCPA)

California residents have the following rights:

  • Right to Know — Request what personal information we have collected about you over the past 12 months.
  • Right to Delete — Request that we delete the information we have collected from you.
  • Right to Opt-Out — We do not sell your information to any third parties.
  • Right to Non-Discrimination — You will not be discriminated against for exercising any of these rights.

To exercise your California privacy rights, email us at info@speedyins.com or call toll-free (866) 577-3339. We aim to respond within 45 days.

Changes to This Policy

Speedy Insurance reviews this Policy regularly to ensure compliance with laws and industry standards. We reserve the right to change this Policy at any time. Changes will be posted on this page. We encourage you to check our website frequently for updates.

Legal

Términos y Condiciones

1. Introduction

Welcome to Speedy Insurance Agency. By accessing or using our services, including receiving SMS communications, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not engage with our services.

2. Consent for SMS Communication

By providing your consent to receive SMS communications, you acknowledge and agree to receive text messages from Speedy Insurance at the phone number you provide. Information obtained as part of the SMS consent process will not be shared with third parties.

3. Types of SMS Communications

If you have consented to receive text messages, you may receive SMS communications related to: updates regarding your policy, quotes, or other relevant information; and job applicants may receive information about application status or onboarding materials.

4. Standard Messaging Disclosures

Message frequency may vary depending on your interactions with us. Standard messaging rates will be charged by your mobile service provider.

  • Reply STOP to opt out of SMS messages at any time.
  • Reply HELP for assistance, or call us at (951) 695-1500.
  • Email us at privacy@speedyins.com

5. Privacy

We respect your privacy and will only use the information you provide to communicate with you as outlined above. Personal information, including phone numbers and SMS consent, will not be shared, sold, rented, or disclosed to any third parties for marketing purposes.

6. Modifications

We reserve the right to update or modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date. By continuing to engage with our services, you agree to be bound by any changes to these terms.
